#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    const int shift = 15;
    const int maxn = 60;
    const int sizePlus = maxn + 1;
    const int sizeMinus = maxn + 1;
    const int sizeCarry = shift * 2 + 1;
    const int totalSize = sizePlus * sizeMinus * sizeCarry;

    vector<int> dp(totalSize, INT_MAX);
    dp[maxn * sizeMinus * sizeCarry + maxn * sizeCarry + shift] = 0;

    string input;
    cin >> input;
    string s = "000" + input;
    int len = s.length();

    for (int i = len - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
        int digit = s[i] - '0';

        // Relaxation: suffix minima over plus and minus
        for (int plus = maxn; plus >= 0; --plus) {
            for (int minus = maxn; minus >= 0; --minus) {
                int base = plus * sizeMinus * sizeCarry + minus * sizeCarry;
                for (int carry = 0; carry < sizeCarry; ++carry) {
                    int idx = base + carry;
                    if (plus + 1 <= maxn) {
                        int idx2 = (plus + 1) * sizeMinus * sizeCarry + minus * sizeCarry + carry;
                        dp[idx] = min(dp[idx], dp[idx2]);
                    }
                    if (minus + 1 <= maxn) {
                        int idx2 = plus * sizeMinus * sizeCarry + (minus + 1) * sizeCarry + carry;
                        dp[idx] = min(dp[idx], dp[idx2]);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        vector<int> next(totalSize, INT_MAX);
        for (int plus = maxn; plus >= 0; --plus) {
            for (int minus = maxn; minus >= 0; --minus) {
                int base = plus * sizeMinus * sizeCarry + minus * sizeCarry;
                for (int carry = 0; carry < sizeCarry; ++carry) {
                    int idx = base + carry;
                    int val = dp[idx];
                    if (val == INT_MAX) continue;
                    int realCarry = carry - shift;
                    int curN = plus - minus + realCarry;
                    int curD = curN % 10;
                    if (curD < 0) curD += 10;
                    int newCarry = (curN - curD) / 10;
                    if (curD != digit) continue;
                    int nidx = plus * sizeMinus * sizeCarry + minus * sizeCarry + (newCarry + shift);
                    next[nidx] = min(next[nidx], plus + minus + val);
                }
            }
        }
        dp = move(next);
    }

    int ans = INT_MAX;
    for (int i = 0; i <= maxn; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= maxn; ++j) {
            ans = min(ans, dp[i * sizeMinus * sizeCarry + j * sizeCarry + shift]);
        }
    }
    cout << ans << endl;

    return 0;
}
